description: Read, edit, or batch-edit files using hash-anchored line references (LN#HASH, currently LN#HHH). Use op:'read' to get anchors, op:'edit' for single changes, op:'batch' for multiple edits in one call. Anchors come from the most recent read and detect stale context before any write.

action.description: Edit action: replace, insert, delete, or replace-range. Defaults to replace unless end_anchor or after imply otherwise.

anchor.description: LN#HASH anchor, e.g. 12#NKT; legacy 2-character anchors are accepted by current hledit

content.description: Replacement or inserted content; empty = delete

context.description: Surrounding lines for grep results; default 2 when grep is set, use 0 for match-only

after.description: Not supported for batch; use op:'edit' for insert-after

end_anchor.description: End LN#HASH anchor for range replace/delete

op.description: Batch edit op: replace, delete, or insert

edits.description: Batch edits as a structured array, or a legacy JSON string. Each edit uses op replace/delete/insert, anchor, optional end_anchor, and lines.

name: hledit
title: Hashline Edit
